$comment: The AAF (Astrological Automated Format) chunk definitions used by src/domain/aaf.ts (#591). Transcribed from the official AAF'97 format specification published at http://www.astrowissen.de/aaf/eng/lib/aafspecs.htm (sections 2 and 4, dated 3 Feb 1997). Nothing is copied from the AAF library or its sample programs. Machine-readable; one entry per chunk.

aaf-format-1997.title: AAF Format Definition (AAF'97)
aaf-format-1997.authors: Martin Garms, Tobias Ferber (per the page's own introduction)
aaf-format-1997.licence: No licence is stated on the specification pages. The AAF library is commercial and copyrighted (1994-97); this file implements from the specification's field descriptions and examples only.

A93.date: day.month.year, '.' separators; year includes the century; optional g (Gregorian) or j (Julian) suffix; years BCE negative (1 BCE = 0, 4 BCE = -3)
A93.time: hh:mm or hh:mm:ss, or hhhmm with h in place of the colon; minutes and seconds optional

B93.latitude: degrees then n (north) or s (south), minutes, optional seconds after a colon
B93.longitude: degrees then e (east) or w (west), minutes, optional seconds after a colon
B93.greenwichOffset: hours then he (east of Greenwich) or hw (west), minutes optional; * when unknown or local mean time
B93.julianDay: * is recommended, since the date and time determine it

SRC.meaning: the kind of source, e.g. birth certificate

VIA.meaning: who researched the data, or the publication

colon.meaning: the invisible #: chunk: readers ignore it entirely; used here for the Astraya extension bag

rules: A record begins with #A93 followed by any number of other chunks.
Each chunk starts in the leftmost column with #ID, then a colon, then comma-separated fields.
Fields cannot contain commas. Leading and trailing white space is ignored.
An asterisk * in a field means the value is unknown.
Everything before the first #A93 is ignored.
Sub-records (#SUBn) and computed chunks (#LPOS, #HPOS and so on) are not produced by this interchange path; the spec says charts are recomputed rather than stored.
